system.description:
You manifest acidic chakra in the form of whips of acid designed to grapple and melt into your foes.

As an action on each of your turns, you can make two ranged ninjutsu attack, dealing 2d6 acid damage on a hit against a creature you target within range. Once per Creatures you hit must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, they become Grappled by you and your acid whips for the duration. A creature Grappled by your acid whips takes 1d12 acid damage at the beginning of each of their turns.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the number of attacks you make by +1. If this jutsu is cast at C-Rank or higher, increase the damage a Grappled creature takes at the beginning of their turns by +1d12. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, a Grappled creature suffers a-2 penalty to their AC. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, increase the damage a Grappled creature takes at the beginning of their turns by +1d12. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank increase the range of this jutsu to 30-feet.
